description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: Upgrade to .NET 10 LTS was explicitly requested. .NET Framework 4.8 is legacy, Windows-only and receives no new features; moving to .NET 10 provides long-term support, improved performance, security updates and modern API/package compatibility.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0, including project file modernization, web framework migration, dependency updates, and API compatibility fixes.
tasks.taskSummary: Migrated ContosoUniversity from .NET Framework 4.8 and ASP.NET MVC 5 to SDK-style .NET 10 and ASP.NET Core MVC. Updated EF Core and configuration, replaced MSMQ notifications, modernized uploads and static assets, and updated documentation. Build passed; no unit-test project exists, so unit tests were not applicable.
